services.name: Fishing Season
services.desc: If you are an avid fisherman, we recommend booking 4 trips throughout the course of the fishing season to experience all the Long Island Sound has to offer. “Spring Migration” - Tremendous Striped Bass fishing! Black Sea Bass and Jumbo Scup too! - Boats from Eastern CT, Western CT and New York travel to fish our waters every single day! - Fishing is often -As Good As It Gets! *Book early for these trips! Alot of dates are booked over a year in advance! All trips are mixed species trips with effort focused on Striped Bass and Bluefish for approximately half the trip. We then target our seasonal Porgies and Black Sea Bass the remaining half of the trip. Every trip is a surprise! The summer
